problem_statement: Build a brand-new Sales CRM page from scratch at the /crm route of this Horizon UI Chakra admin dashboard. The route /crm does not exist in baseline (empty). Construct the full page reusing the site's Chakra design system (Card component, brand colors, spacing, fonts): a page header with title 'Sales CRM' and an 'Add new deal' primary button, a row of KPI stat cards (Active Leads / Win Rate / Pipeline Value / Closed This Q), and a 'Deal Pipeline' card with a stage tab strip (New Leads / In Negotiation / Closed Won) that swaps the visible deal list and panel heading when a tab is clicked. Must be responsive with no horizontal overflow on mobile.
required_content: Page header with an h1 title 'Sales CRM' and a subtitle
Primary 'Add new deal' button in the header, styled with the Chakra brand variant
Four KPI stat cards: Active Leads, Win Rate, Pipeline Value, Closed This Q, each reusing the Card component
A 'Deal Pipeline' card (h3) containing a tab strip with three stages: New Leads, In Negotiation, Closed Won
Active-stage panel with an h3 heading matching the selected stage and a list of deals (name, owner avatar, value)
Clicking a stage tab swaps the visible panel heading and deal list (client-side state)
Responsive layout: stat cards and tabs stack cleanly on mobile with no horizontal overflow
When the In Negotiation tab is clicked, the active panel h3 heading changes to "In Negotiation" and the deal list updates accordingly (Closed Won tab similarly swaps the panel)
design_constraints: Reuse the Chakra Card component from components/card/Card.js
Use the theme brand color (brand.500 #422AFB) for the primary button and active tab
Use useColorModeValue for light/dark text + surface colors like the other views
Match Horizon UI spacing/border-radius idioms (16px radii, 20px gaps)

Match the reference color palette: page background #F4F7FE (rgb(244,247,254)), primary/brand action color #422AFB (rgb(66,42,251)) for the Add-new-deal button and the active stage tab, surface/card background #FFFFFF, navy heading text #1B2559 (rgb(27,37,89)), muted secondary text #A3AED0 (rgb(163,174,208)) for inactive tabs, and success green #01B574 (rgb(1,181,116)) for positive KPI deltas
Use the DM Sans font family and Chakra idioms: 16px radius on primary button/cards, 12px radius on tab buttons, 600/700 font-weights for buttons/headings, subtle Horizon shadows
author_notes: 方案A: baseline registers an empty top-level /crm route (element=<></>) so the route renders blank (no shell chrome); reference implements the full standalone Chakra CRM page mounted as a top-level route (sibling of admin/*); bad hardcodes the pipeline panel to STAGES.leads so tab clicks move the highlight but never change the panel heading/list (interaction broken). Three workspace source trees md5-distinct. Interaction click keyed on button[data-tab="negotiation"] (gotcha #18l data-attr, not shell-chrome text).
